info.description: Control's public deploy surface: deploy submit, run reads, and workspace deployment projections.
info.title: Putnami Control API

get.description:
List a workspace's deploy runs newest-first, offset-paginated (limit/offset query params). Optional environment and project query params compose and are filtered server-side BEFORE pagination. Project participation comes from the requested release, so an in-flight run remains visible before its per-project result materializes; when available, that matching result is attached. The read side of the deploy history the console run views render. Requires platform.workspace.read resolved at the target workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

400.description: Invalid environment, project, limit, or offset

403.description: Insufficient permissions or workspace scope mismatch

post.description:
Submit a continuous deploy of a workspace environment. The body is {environment, release_id, commit?, publish_v2}: publish_v2 names the release set and the members to roll, and the answer is 202 accepted (poll GET .../deploy/{release}). The success (200/202) schema is DeployPostResponse, the field-union of the release response and the removed hand deploy response (all fields optional). A body without publish_v2 (the classic release {environment, release_id, projects[]} or the hand deploy {app, env, image_version}) answers 410 classic_release_removed: deploy with putnami cloud deploy publish-v2. Requires platform.workspace.deploy resolved at the target workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.deploy.

202.description: Accepted for asynchronous rollout; poll GET .../deploy/{release}. Body is DeployPostResponse; see the operation description.

400.description: Invalid or missing body fields, or a malformed publish_v2 payload

403.description: Insufficient permissions or workspace scope mismatch

409.description: Release id already used for a different deploy

410.description: The body is a classic release or a hand deploy, which Control no longer runs; deploy with putnami cloud deploy publish-v2

get.description:
Status of one release: the persisted run (state + per-project URLs/revisions/failure detail) plus the migration rollout summary. The read side of the async deploy — the CLI polls it after the POST returns a release id. Requires platform.workspace.deploy resolved at the target workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.deploy.

403.description: Insufficient permissions or workspace scope mismatch

404.description: No deploy found for this release

get.description:
Current deployment state for every project × environment in a workspace: revision, URL, health/state, and last-deploy provenance in one call (the J3 CLI status and console Overview read side). Requires platform.workspace.read resolved at the target workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

403.description: Insufficient permissions or workspace scope mismatch

post.description:
Accept the workspace repository's fixed putnami.ci.json declaration at one immutable source revision. An absent or empty sourceRevision selects the repository's default-branch head, which Source resolves to a commit before the read; the receipt names that commit. expectedRevision is the newest accepted revision (0 for none): a stale value is refused with 409. The caller supplies no bytes or repository coordinates. Requires platform.workspace.deploy resolved at the target workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.deploy.

400.description: Malformed selector or invalid source declaration

403.description: Insufficient permissions or workspace scope mismatch

409.description: Source identity or accepted revision conflicts

get.description:
Continuous-delivery state of one environment: every channel it follows in the workspace's accepted environment definition (its own channel first, then each distinct per-workload override) and, for each, the newest channel-move receipt — namespace, generation, release set, moved and received times, disposition, reason, the release ids the move opened, and whether it is settled. Newest is the highest generation within a (namespace, channel); across namespaces the head received most recently wins. A channel with no receipt yet is listed without one, and an environment that follows no channel answers an empty list. Requires platform.workspace.read resolved at the target workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

403.description: Insufficient permissions or workspace scope mismatch

404.description: The workspace has no accepted environment definition, or the environment is not declared in it

503.description: The channel-move ledger is not available or could not be read

get.description:
Read-only first-deploy preflight of one environment: one row per server-side prerequisite — the Put and OCI namespace bindings, the accepted environment definition, Runtime's operation grants for each control caller and its binding grant for config-api, the object ownership of each migrated database, and ledger rows still keyed by a manifest name — in the order they fail during a first deploy. Each row is ok, missing or unknown, and every row that is not ok carries its fix. A source that cannot be read turns its own rows unknown; the response stays a 200. The workloads query lists the environment's workloads as comma-separated `<path>` or `<path>=<manifest name>` entries, and migrated lists the ones that ship a migration bundle; without workloads, the accepted definition's selection is used. Runtime's grants are read with the caller's own bearer. The response also carries required_callers (each identity the grant rows check, with its grant route) and accepted_revision (the expectedRevision the next acceptance must carry), the inputs `putnami cloud env enable` converges from; probe=manage adds caller_can_manage, whether the caller holds platform.workspace.manage in the workspace. Requires platform.workspace.read resolved at the target workspace.

Required scopes: platform.workspace.read.

403.description: Insufficient permissions or workspace scope mismatch
